CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint was progression-free survival at 6 months, but no efficacy results are reported. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This appears to be a severely underpowered study with only 14 participants for a glioblastoma trial. The lack of any efficacy readout suggests the trial was terminated early or failed to complete planned enrollment and analysis.
